description: Implement From trait conversions that allow constructing Line and Text structs directly from slices of compatible types. This will enable more ergonomic creation of these text elements from existing data structures without manual iteration.
functional_requirements: Implement From<&[T]> for Line where T: Into<Span>, allowing conversion from slices of Span-compatible types
Implement From<&[T]> for Text where T: Into<Line>, allowing conversion from slices of Line-compatible types
Ensure the implementations handle empty slices appropriately
Maintain consistency with existing From trait implementations for single elements
